solver.yz_spectral: ALL ORIGINAL 2D yz graph normalized Neumann eigenpairs via symmetric scipy.linalg.eigh (no truncation)

solver.mode_amp: original raw native injected in_sigs[:,0] sum times original 8node source+receiver Euclidean mode overlap, initial u0=0, u1=q0_native_scale*source_projection; q[n>0]=0
solver.pressure_and_frequency: exact original rho dphi/dt second-order one-sided endpoints and centered interior; signed full 250ms direct-frequency analysis P_T/Q_T q0 denominator
solver.analytic_DTFT: same closed-form finite N derivation validated independently on original temporal Leapfrog q0, theta inserted from actual original leapfrog. Full cosine time progression, include first/last sample endpoint derivatives and full 40/80Hz (no Gaussian or temporal filter).
